title: Choose the visual world for Africa Climate Finance
question: The roll assigned Concept Note Register. Keep it, take the pick or the Custody Ribbon challenger, or re-roll.

options.label: Concept Note Register
options.lineage: GCF/Adaptation Fund concept-note & funding-proposal cover sheets
options.thesis: The site reads like the funding-proposal register this org already produces — project IDs, dated custody, one continuous evidence trail — not a brochure.
options.viewport: A dated register header (project ID, place, date) leads into a custody thread of Educate→Finance→Prepare→Place, each stage a stamped lit/unlit state; the hero photo sits inside a document-window frame, never full-bleed.
options.risk: Reads cold/bureaucratic if the stamp-ink accent doesn't carry enough warmth from the real photography.

raised.raise: Custody Thread — a continuous dated line traces capital and people from ward to term sheet, in known/confirmed vs. in-progress states.
Stamp-Ink Discipline — palette held to one paper ground plus two spot inks (approval red, ledger teal), like a real rubber-stamped document, not a broad palette.
Step-State — the four-stage model renders as lit/unlit steps, not a static list, so every page shows which stage is live.

regions.label: register header · project ID / place / date
proof stat rail · license · pipeline value · COP

options.label: Savings-Group Passbook
options.lineage: VSLA savings-group passbooks used across rural Tanzania
options.thesis: The literal object every trained woman in these photos already owns — hand-ruled columns, stamped entries, a running balance — rebuilt as the site's own ledger of contributions and outcomes.
options.viewport: A ruled ledger page as the hero — name, date, contribution, balance — with real photography inset in the margin like a pasted photo.
options.risk: The single most expected literal choice for ‘microfinance’ — needs unusually specific real ledger data (real names, real dates) to avoid reading as decoration.

regions.label: ledger masthead · org name as passbook cover
inset real photo pasted in margin
entries row · seven services as ledger line-items

options.label: Custody Ribbon
options.lineage: museum provenance ribbons tracing an object's custody chain
options.thesis: Every programme, every shilling, traced as one continuous line from community to institution and back — known, in-progress, and disputed states made visible.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with the org's own four-stage model and serves funder and community readers equally by making the capital trail itself the story; loses narrowly to the register world on how instantly a funder recognizes the specific document genre this org actually produces.
options.risk: Can read as a data-viz gimmick unless grounded in real dated waypoints.

regions.label: waypoint detail card · known / in-progress state

options.label: Dawn Cyclorama
options.lineage: theatrical cyclorama lighting, night to day
options.case: Fuses poorly: an atmospheric light-only system has no way to carry hard evidence (license numbers, funding figures) a funder needs.
options.kept: Graduated phase-tone bands marking which pipeline stage a section belongs to.

options.label: Riso Print System
options.case: Fuses poorly: zine-style ink misregistration reads as indie creative-agency, not a licensed financial institution.
options.kept: Restraint to two spot inks, donated to the register world as its stamp-ink discipline.

options.label: Step Row
options.case: Fuses poorly: a music-instrument register undercuts the credibility a climate-finance funder needs.
options.kept: Lit/unlit step states, donated to the register world's four-stage model.

options.label: Registered Woodblock
options.lineage: Edo woodblock print, layered color registration
options.case: Fuses poorly: a Japanese print tradition has no cultural connection to Tanzania or East African climate finance.
options.kept: Layer-by-layer registration reveal, kept only as a motion idea.

options.label: Annotated Uniform Code
options.lineage: school-uniform subculture dress code as annotated document
options.case: Fuses poorly: a fashion-subculture dress code has no audience or product relevance to climate finance.
options.kept: Nothing beyond what document annotation already supports.

canonCard.label: Climate-NGO Standard
canonCard.thesis: Drone-shot green hills, translucent teal-overlay hero, icon-grid services, logo-strip trust bar — the default every climate/development org ships.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed drone/community photo hero with a teal gradient, centered white headline, three-icon service row below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other climate-finance or development NGO site — exactly what the brief asked to avoid.
